leverage.exposure: No leverage, and none is being recommended. The balance is positive, the recommended bid stays inside available cash, and it cannot drive the balance below zero even if it wins. This matters because a negative balance at the start of a matchday scores nothing for the entire matchday, and it is the reason the leveraged version of this buy was rejected even though it was affordable — it would have bought no extra chance of winning the player.

binding_gap: A third attacker. The squad is one body above the penalty threshold and short in exactly one position, which is why only 4-4-2 is legal and why a player with no points is compulsory in the eleven. Adding an attacker fixes the shape and the points problem in the same move, which is why it outranks every other use of the cash.

verdict.headline: Raise the Conté offer to the full cash ceiling before it resolves around midday Saturday, and do nothing else.

verdict.detail: Raise the Conté offer to the full cash ceiling before it resolves around midday Saturday, and do nothing else. This corrects the last briefing on a point of fact: it told you Hoffenheim–BVB was being played that evening and that this run would decide with Conté's result in hand. That match had not been played. It kicks off Saturday afternoon, and the listing resolves shortly before kickoff — so no result was ever going to arrive, and waiting buys no information at all. The bid has to be set on the pre-match evidence, which is all there will ever be.

sell.reason: Nothing to sell, and nothing that can be sold. At the eleven-player floor every sale is a penalty, so the question does not arise until a buy lands first. Once Conté is in, Amoako becomes sellable without costing a single fielded point — he leaves the eleven the moment a third attacker legalises 4-3-3. The standing advice still says keep him anyway: at twelve players he is the only injury cover in the squad, and the cash he would raise buys nothing better.

buy.reason: Conté is the whole briefing. He is the best points-per-euro on the board, he is a confirmed starter, and he is the single largest points gain available — a third attacker legalises 4-3-3, which pushes Amoako's zero out of the eleven. The argument this run is about price, not merit. The existing offer sits in the dead space between the two things that actually happen in this league: uncontested listings clear at roughly market value, contested ones clear far above it. A bid in the middle beats nobody serious and overpays if nobody turns up. The fix is to move up to the full cash ceiling, which clears most of the contested outcomes ever measured here. The reason to stop exactly there, and not to borrow against a later sale: the leveraged ceiling would clear precisely the same set of measured outcomes, because there is a wide empty gap in the record just above the cash ceiling. Leverage buys no extra chance of winning him, while opening a negative balance and forcing the Amoako sale that strips the squad's only injury cover. Cash needs no sale, cannot go negative, and ends the week at twelve players with cover. The honest cost: if nobody else bids, the extra is simply burned, because you pay your own bid here. That is insurance on the only large points gain on the board, bought with cash that has no better use before matchday 3. Everything else on the board was checked and rejected — the big names are all far worse per point than players already owned, and the cheap ones are cheap because their clubs are not playing them.

standing.name: Bambase Conte
standing.why: RAISE the live offer from 10.400.000 to 11.343.624 = the FULL CASH ceiling, +22,08% over mv 9.292.405. Replaces closed Bduul6s (price revision only; its points case and fitness case both stand). THE POINTS CASE, UNCHANGED AND RE-VERIFIED: squad is 11 = 1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT, only 4-4-2 is legal, so Amoako ap 0 is compulsory in the XI. Conte makes it 12 = 1/4/4/3, legalises 4-3-3, and Amoako drops out: 1333 -> 1439 = +106, the largest single action available. He is also the best efficiency on the board at 9.292.405/106 = 87,7k per point (Rohr 111,8k is the next real candidate). FITNESS RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN on a dated source: Sports Mole preview 04.09.2026 01:36Z starts him in the Hoffenheim XI (Baumann; Coufal, Hajdari, Kabak, Bernardo; Avdullahu, Burger; Wimmer, CONTE, Daghim; Lemperle), TSG absentees only Asllani (knee) and Prass (muscle); Ligainsider verletzte-und-gesperrte lists ZERO Hoffenheim players; Kickbase st 0, stl []. WHY RAISE, AND WHY EXACTLY TO CASH. Georg's +11,92% sits in the bimodal dead space - uncontested listings clear at ~0% (measured 8 for 8), contested ones at +9% to +61%, so it beats only 1 of the 9 measured contested clearings while overpaying 1,1M if nobody comes. At +22,08% it beats 6 of 9. THE DECISIVE ARITHMETIC AGAINST LEVERAGE: the no-points-lost leveraged ceiling (cash + Amoako 1.569.143 = 12.912.767 = +38,97%) beats the SAME 6 of 9, because the next measured clearing above +20,96% is +48,28%. Leverage therefore buys ZERO additional win probability against the measured distribution while opening a negative balance and forcing the Amoako sale that removes the squad's only injury cover. Take the cash ceiling: no sale, balance stays positive, squad ends at 12 with cover. HONEST COST: if the listing stays uncontested he pays 2.051.219 over mv rather than 1.107.595 - an extra 943.624 burned for insurance on the only +106 on the board, against idle cash with no better use before MD3. Even at the full bid he is 107,0k per point, still better than Minjae, Nusa, Baumann, Guirassy and Lokonga.

REJECTED ON EFFICIENCY AND ON AFFORDABILITY, and logged because ap 132 attached to an established international is precisely the shape that tempts a run into the Chabot/Kimmich trap. (1) POINTS PER EURO: 24.285.098 / 132 = 184,0k per fielded point. Every outfielder in Georg's squad is better — Gregoritsch 60,7k, ter Horst 60,5k, Onyeka 65,0k, Widmer 63,2k, Matsima 102,7k, Minjae 110,1k — and both live buy candidates crush him: Conté 9.198.968 / 106 = 86,8k, Rohr 9.651.515 / 87 = 110,9k. (2) HE WOULD NOT EVEN IMPROVE THE ELEVEN MUCH: as a fifth defender he makes the squad 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT whose best legal shape is 5-3-2, and at ap 132 he enters ahead of Widmer 29 for +103 — fractionally LESS than Conté's +106 at a QUARTER of the price. (3) UNAFFORDABLE WITHOUT WRECKING THE SQUAD: cash is 11.343.624, so he needs roughly 13M of sales on top, and the only players worth that are Guirassy 30.479.722 (ap 180) or Nusa 26.660.682 (ap 226) — selling 180 or 226 to buy 132 is a straight loss before you count the two transaction spreads. (4) His ap 132 is a ONE-MATCH figure like every ap in this league (Hp0rkuf) and will regress. REVERSAL CONDITION: only if his mv falls under roughly 110k per point (about 14,5M at ap 132, or proportionally at whatever his post-MD2 ap turns out to be) AND Georg is holding idle cash he cannot deploy on a better efficiency AND he still projects as a Frankfurt starter on a source dated at that time. Being Robin Koch is not a reversal condition.

movers.reason: No flip this run. There are no manager listings on the board at all, so the mechanism that would fund a value trade is simply absent. The rivals' constant same-day round trips have now been measured across dozens of pairs and the best margin any of them has ever achieved is under one percent, because they buy and sell at market value on both sides and pocket nothing but the intraday drift. That is motion, not points, and it is not worth copying.

fitness.sweep: Clean sweep — no squad player is injured, suspended, or newly benched. All eleven carry no status flag in Kickbase, and none of them appears on the league-wide injured-and-suspended table, checked club by club. Conté himself is confirmed fit and starting on a source dated today, his club lists only two absentees and he is not among them, and the injury table shows no Hoffenheim players at all. Two selection questions remain genuinely open — one attacker and one defender whose places in their club sides are disputed between sources — but in both cases the deciding press conference falls after the matchday-2 side was already locked, so there is nothing to act on and neither is an injury concern.
